verdict.rationale: GitLab's Duo Agent Platform lets users create custom flows that automate team processes, and it explicitly says you "define triggers to control when the flow runs" (gitlab-docs-59, gitlab-docs-36). Agents can also be triggered directly from discussions, issues or merge requests (gitlab-docs-58). This is a first-party, user-defined event-to-action automation, but the documentation describing it is brief. Missing for 10: detail on which event types and rule conditions are supported, examples of automatic (non-manual) event triggering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
